who.en:
Afya Men is the monthly grooming and health box for a man aged 20 to 59 in Dar es Salaam. It carries what he uses every day — razors and shaving gel, an antiperspirant, soap, face wash, sunscreen, body lotion and the three things that keep teeth and gums healthy — and pairs them with a free blood-pressure check each month at the Afya Check in the store.

Blood pressure is the health reason for the box. In Tanzania’s 2023 national STEPS survey, 23.1% of adults aged 18–69 had raised blood pressure; the share rose from 12.6% at ages 18–30 to 46.4% at ages 46–69, and was 36.4% among overweight or obese adults. Most people with high blood pressure feel nothing, and WHO says the only way to know is to have it measured. In the last national survey to measure control (2012), only about 2 in every 100 adults with hypertension had it under control. Men in their working years rarely visit a clinic when they feel well, so a monthly visit to collect or check the box is a chance to measure them.

Skin and sun. Razor bumps are among the most common skin problems in men with tightly coiled beard hair, and they can leave dark marks that the sun deepens. The shave items follow the American Academy of Dermatology’s advice (shave with the grain, on softened skin, with a sharp blade). Dar es Salaam is close to the equator; WHO advises sun protection whenever the UV index is 3 or more and notes that darker-skinned people also develop skin cancers, so a daily face sunscreen is in the core.

Teeth and gums. WHO recommends brushing twice a day with a fluoride toothpaste of 1,000–1,500 ppm; gum disease is driven mainly by poor oral hygiene and tobacco. The box carries fluoride toothpaste, a brush replaced every three months and floss.

When to see a clinic. A reading of 140/90 or more at the Afya Check is a screening result, not a diagnosis: WHO diagnoses hypertension when readings on two different days are 140/90 or higher, so the member is referred to a clinic to confirm it. A reading around 180/120 with severe headache, chest pain, breathlessness, blurred vision or confusion needs care immediately. Razor bumps that become painful, pus-filled or leave spreading dark marks, bleeding or swollen gums, and any new or changing spot on the skin are also for a clinician. The box contains no medicine.
who.sw:
Afya Men ni sanduku la kila mwezi la usafi na afya kwa mwanaume wa miaka 20 hadi 59 jijini Dar es Salaam. Lina vitu anavyotumia kila siku — nyembe na jeli ya kunyolea, roll-on ya kuzuia jasho, sabuni, sabuni ya uso, kinga ya jua, losheni ya mwili na vitu vitatu vinavyotunza meno na fizi — pamoja na kipimo cha bure cha shinikizo la damu kila mwezi kwenye Afya Check dukani.

Shinikizo la damu ndiyo sababu ya kiafya ya sanduku hili. Katika utafiti wa kitaifa wa STEPS wa mwaka 2023 nchini Tanzania, asilimia 23.1 ya watu wazima wa miaka 18–69 walikuwa na shinikizo la juu la damu; kiwango kilipanda kutoka asilimia 12.6 kwa wenye miaka 18–30 hadi asilimia 46.4 kwa wenye miaka 46–69, na kilikuwa asilimia 36.4 kwa wenye uzito uliozidi au unene uliopitiliza. Watu wengi wenye shinikizo la juu la damu hawahisi chochote, na WHO inasema njia pekee ya kujua ni kupimwa. Katika utafiti wa mwisho wa kitaifa uliopima udhibiti (2012), ni takriban watu 2 kati ya kila 100 wenye shinikizo la juu la damu waliokuwa wamelidhibiti. Wanaume walio katika miaka ya kazi mara chache huenda kliniki wanapojisikia vizuri, hivyo kufika dukani kila mwezi kuchukua au kukagua sanduku ni nafasi ya kuwapima.

Ngozi na jua. Vipele vya kunyoa ni miongoni mwa matatizo ya ngozi yanayowapata zaidi wanaume wenye ndevu zilizojikunja sana, na vinaweza kuacha alama nyeusi ambazo jua huziongeza. Bidhaa za kunyoa zinafuata ushauri wa Chama cha Madaktari wa Ngozi cha Marekani (kunyoa kufuata mwelekeo wa nywele, kwenye ngozi iliyolainishwa, kwa wembe mkali). Dar es Salaam iko karibu na ikweta; WHO inashauri kujikinga na jua kila kipimo cha UV kinapofika 3 au zaidi na inaeleza kwamba watu wenye ngozi nyeusi pia hupata saratani ya ngozi, hivyo kinga ya jua ya uso ya kila siku imo kwenye msingi wa sanduku.

Meno na fizi. WHO inapendekeza kupiga mswaki mara mbili kwa siku kwa dawa ya meno yenye floraidi ya ppm 1,000–1,500; magonjwa ya fizi husababishwa hasa na usafi duni wa kinywa na tumbaku. Sanduku lina dawa ya meno yenye floraidi, mswaki unaobadilishwa kila miezi mitatu na uzi wa meno.

Wakati wa kwenda kliniki. Kipimo cha 140/90 au zaidi kwenye Afya Check ni matokeo ya uchunguzi wa awali, si utambuzi: WHO hutambua shinikizo la juu la damu vipimo vya siku mbili tofauti vinapokuwa 140/90 au zaidi, hivyo mwanachama hupelekwa kliniki kuthibitisha. Kipimo cha karibu 180/120 pamoja na maumivu makali ya kichwa, maumivu ya kifua, kushindwa kupumua, kuona ukungu au kuchanganyikiwa kinahitaji huduma mara moja. Vipele vya kunyoa vinavyouma, vyenye usaha au vinavyoacha alama nyeusi zinazoenea, fizi zinazotoka damu au kuvimba, na doa lolote jipya au linalobadilika kwenye ngozi pia ni kwa mtaalamu wa afya. Sanduku halina dawa.

clinic_line.en: The blood-pressure reading at the Afya Check is a screening, not a diagnosis. Whether you have high blood pressure, how often to check it and any medicine are decided by your clinic; a reading of 180/120 or more with chest pain, severe headache, breathlessness or blurred vision needs care immediately.
clinic_line.sw: Kipimo cha shinikizo la damu kwenye Afya Check ni uchunguzi wa awali, si utambuzi. Kama una shinikizo la juu la damu, mara ngapi upime na dawa yoyote huamuliwa na kliniki yako; kipimo cha 180/120 au zaidi pamoja na maumivu ya kifua, maumivu makali ya kichwa, kushindwa kupumua au kuona ukungu kinahitaji huduma mara moja.

why.en: Razor bumps (pseudofolliculitis barbae) are among the most common skin problems in men with tightly coiled beard hair: a hair cut very close curls back and grows into the skin. The American Academy of Dermatology’s advice is to shave in the direction the hair grows, on skin softened with water and gel, with a sharp blade and as few strokes as possible (AAD guidance, not re-opened). A fresh razor every four shaves keeps the blade sharp. The default is a single-blade razor; twin-blade and system razors are swaps. A man who keeps a full beard or uses clippers can drop this line in the app.
why.sw: Vipele vya kunyoa (pseudofolliculitis barbae) ni miongoni mwa matatizo ya ngozi yanayowapata zaidi wanaume wenye ndevu zilizojikunja sana: unywele ukinyolewa karibu sana hujipinda na kuota ndani ya ngozi. Ushauri wa Chama cha Madaktari wa Ngozi cha Marekani (AAD) ni kunyoa kufuata mwelekeo wa nywele, kwenye ngozi iliyolainishwa kwa maji na jeli, kwa wembe mkali na kupitisha mara chache iwezekanavyo (mwongozo wa AAD, haujafunguliwa upya). Wembe mpya kila baada ya kunyoa mara nne huweka makali. Chaguo la msingi ni wembe wa ubapa mmoja; nyembe za ubapa miwili na za mfumo ni mbadala. Mwanaume anayefuga ndevu au anayetumia mashine anaweza kuondoa bidhaa hii kwenye programu.

items.qty_formula: about 4 shaves a week × 4.3 weeks ≈ 17 shaves ÷ about 4 shaves per razor ≈ 4 razors (planning assumption)

why.en: Wetting the beard and using a shaving foam or gel softens the hair, so the blade cuts with fewer strokes and less pull: the AAD steps against cuts, irritation and razor bumps (not re-opened). A sensitive-skin gel is offered for men who get irritation.
why.sw: Kulowesha ndevu na kutumia povu au jeli ya kunyolea hulainisha nywele, hivyo wembe hukata kwa kupitisha mara chache na kuvuta kidogo: hizi ni hatua za AAD dhidi ya michubuko, muwasho na vipele vya kunyoa (haujafunguliwa upya). Jeli ya ngozi nyeti inapatikana kwa wanaume wanaopata muwasho.

why.en: Dar es Salaam is hot and humid all year, and most men work or commute in that heat. Underarm sweat is odourless; the smell comes when skin bacteria break it down. An antiperspirant roll-on reduces sweat and a deodorant masks odour, so a daily roll-on keeps a man fresh through a working day. Roll-ons are chosen over aerosols because they last longer per shilling and travel safely in a box.
why.sw: Dar es Salaam ina joto na unyevu mwaka mzima, na wanaume wengi hufanya kazi au kusafiri katika joto hilo. Jasho la kwapani halina harufu; harufu hutokea bakteria wa ngozi wanapolivunja. Roll-on ya kuzuia jasho hupunguza jasho na deodoranti hufunika harufu, hivyo roll-on ya kila siku humweka mwanaume safi siku nzima ya kazi. Roll-on zimechaguliwa badala ya spray kwa sababu hudumu zaidi kwa kila shilingi na husafirishwa salama ndani ya sanduku.

items.qty_formula: about 1.5 ml a day for both underarms × 30 days ≈ 45–50 ml = 1 roll-on (planning assumption)

why.en: Washing with soap and water removes sweat, oil and the bacteria that cause body odour and skin infections. In Dar’s heat many men shower twice a day. A plain bar is the cheapest effective wash; an antibacterial bar is a swap, not a need.
why.sw: Kuoga kwa sabuni na maji huondoa jasho, mafuta na bakteria wanaosababisha harufu ya mwili na maambukizi ya ngozi. Katika joto la Dar wanaume wengi huoga mara mbili kwa siku. Kipande cha sabuni ya kawaida ndicho njia nafuu zaidi inayofanya kazi; sabuni ya kuua bakteria ni mbadala, si lazima.

why.en: The AAD advises men to wash the face daily and after heavy sweating with a mild face wash rather than ordinary bar soap, which can dry the skin (not re-opened). Clean skin before shaving also lowers the risk of infected razor bumps.

name.en: Sunscreen for the face, SPF 30 or higher

why.en: Dar es Salaam lies close to the equator, so the sun is strong all year. WHO advises sun protection whenever the UV index is 3 or above, and broad-spectrum sunscreen on skin that clothes do not cover; it notes that darker-skinned people also develop skin cancers, and that outdoor workers face a higher risk. Sun also deepens the dark patches and uneven tone that razor bumps leave on the face. A hat and shade come first; sunscreen covers the face, ears and neck. It doubles as the face moisturiser.
why.sw: Dar es Salaam iko karibu na ikweta, hivyo jua ni kali mwaka mzima. WHO inashauri kujikinga na jua kila kipimo cha UV kinapofika 3 au zaidi, na kupaka kinga ya jua ya wigo mpana kwenye ngozi isiyofunikwa na nguo; inaeleza kwamba watu wenye ngozi nyeusi pia hupata saratani ya ngozi, na kwamba wanaofanya kazi nje wako kwenye hatari kubwa zaidi. Jua pia huongeza weusi wa mabaka na rangi isiyo sawa ambayo vipele vya kunyoa huacha usoni. Kofia na kivuli huja kwanza; kinga ya jua hufunika uso, masikio na shingo. Inatumika pia kama losheni ya uso.

why.en: Frequent washing in heat strips the skin’s oils, and dry, “ashy” skin on the legs, arms and hands is common. The AAD advises men to moisturise after bathing, when the skin is still damp (not re-opened). Petroleum jelly is the cheapest option for very dry patches.
why.sw: Kuoga mara kwa mara katika joto huondoa mafuta ya asili ya ngozi, na ngozi kavu yenye “ukavu mweupe” miguuni, mikononi na viganjani ni jambo la kawaida. AAD inawashauri wanaume kupaka losheni baada ya kuoga, ngozi ikiwa bado na unyevu kidogo (haujafunguliwa upya). Mafuta ya mgando (petroleum jelly) ndiyo njia nafuu zaidi kwa sehemu zilizokauka sana.

why.en: WHO: adequate fluoride is essential against tooth decay, and twice-daily brushing with a fluoride toothpaste of 1,000–1,500 ppm should be encouraged. Gum disease is driven mainly by poor oral hygiene and tobacco use, and WHO links oral disease to the same risk factors as heart disease and diabetes. Only fluoride toothpastes are offered.
why.sw: WHO: floraidi ya kutosha ni muhimu dhidi ya kuoza kwa meno, na kupiga mswaki mara mbili kwa siku kwa dawa ya meno yenye floraidi ya ppm 1,000–1,500 kunapaswa kuhimizwa. Magonjwa ya fizi husababishwa hasa na usafi duni wa kinywa na matumizi ya tumbaku, na WHO inahusisha magonjwa ya kinywa na vihatarishi vilevile vya magonjwa ya moyo na kisukari. Ni dawa za meno zenye floraidi tu zinazotolewa.

why.en: Brushing removes the plaque that causes decay and gum disease (WHO). A worn brush cleans poorly; the NHS advises a new brush every three months (not re-opened).

open.en: Monthly home delivery does not pay its way on the 6- and 12-month plans: a basket of about TSh 40,000 cannot carry TSh 7,000 of packing and delivery at a 6–9% member saving. Proposed fix: collect the box in store at the monthly Afya Check, or take home delivery every two months; monthly home delivery on the 6- and 12-month plans needs a basket of at least TSh 56,900 (12 months) or 45,500 (6 months). Founder decision.
open.sw: Kuleta sanduku nyumbani kila mwezi hakulipi gharama zake kwenye mipango ya miezi 6 na 12: kikapu cha takriban TSh 40,000 hakiwezi kubeba TSh 7,000 za kufunga na kusafirisha kwa punguzo la asilimia 6–9 kwa mwanachama. Pendekezo: kuchukua sanduku dukani wakati wa Afya Check ya kila mwezi, au kuletewa nyumbani kila baada ya miezi miwili; kuletewa kila mwezi kwenye mipango ya miezi 6 na 12 kunahitaji kikapu cha angalau TSh 56,900 (miezi 12) au 45,500 (miezi 6). Uamuzi wa mwanzilishi.

open.en: The Afya Check (blood pressure, weight and BMI) is free in store. Its referral rule and the partner clinic that confirms a raised reading are to be set in R2 and R7.
